The gap

A degree says what you studied. Employers want to see what you can do.

Between finishing a course and doing well at work there is a long stretch that most students cross alone. Digitaleem works in that stretch.

  • Students understand the theoryhave not solved practical problems
  • They hold certificateshave no meaningful projects
  • They complete internshipsgain little real experience
  • They reach final yearhave barely met anyone from their industry
  • They know the subjectstruggle to show it in an interview

Where are you starting?

Everyone starts from a different place.

Pick the stage that sounds most like you. You can join Digitaleem at any of them, and move on when you are ready.

How to start

Four steps, no payment online.

  1. Tell us where you are

    Fill in a short form about your course, your field and what you need.

  2. We call you

  3. You get a plan

  4. You start

Questions

What students ask us.

Who can join?

Students in any year of a degree, diploma or ITI course, recent graduates, qualified nurses, and early-career professionals who want to move into a new field.

Is Digitaleem only for IT students?

No. We work with engineering, polytechnic and ITI students in core branches, with business and management students and with nurses, as well as IT.

Can you help me work abroad?

Yes, starting with nursing in Germany. See nursing careers in Germany and Language for work.

Do you guarantee a job?

No one can honestly guarantee a job. What we do is help you build skills, projects and experience that employers look for, prepare you for interviews, and connect you with companies that are hiring.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the program. We share fees on the call after your enquiry. There is no payment on this website.

Are programs online or offline?

Programs run online at launch. Internships and industrial training take place where the host company works. Offline centres will open in stages.

content:
Home/Careers abroad/Nursing in Germany

Nursing careers in Germany

Your nursing career, in Germany.

Hospitals and care homes in Germany need qualified nurses, and they hire from India. Digitaleem prepares you for every step: the language, recognition of your degree, interviews with employers and the move itself.

Check if you are eligibleSee the route

Who it is for

Qualified nurses ready for a new country.

You do not need any German to start. You do need your qualification, your registration and the commitment to learn.

  • B.Sc Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc, M.Sc Nursing or GNM
  • Registered with a State Nursing Council
  • Clinical experience helps, and many employers prefer it
  • Ready to learn German to B1 or B2 level
  • Ready to relocate and build a career in Germany

The route

Seven steps, from your first German word to your first shift.

Language classes run online. Exams are taken at authorised centres, and interviews are held online with employers in Germany.

  1. Check eligibility

    We review your qualification, registration and experience, and tell you honestly whether the route fits you now.

  2. Learn German

    Live classes from A1 to B1 or B2, the level German employers and authorities ask for, with exam preparation.

  3. Add medical German

    Handovers, documentation, care plans and conversations with patients and their families.

  4. Get your degree recognised

    We help you prepare the documents for recognition of your nursing qualification in Germany (Anerkennung).

  5. Meet employers

    Interview preparation, then interviews with hospitals and care homes in Germany.

  6. Prepare to move

    Guidance on your visa, travel and first weeks, so you arrive knowing what to expect.

  7. Start work

    You begin work. If recognition asks for an adaptation period or a knowledge exam, we help you prepare for it.

Fair recruitment

You should never have to pay for a job.

  • Placement feesnone for nurses
  • Recruitment costspaid by the employer
  • Your contractshown to you before you commit
  • Our advicehonest, even when the answer is not yet

For employers in Germany

Hospitals, care homes and home care services: tell us the roles you need to fill. We prepare candidates in German, medical German and the way care works in Germany, and we stay with them through recognition.

Recruit nurses from India
  • Language to the level you set, with medical German
  • Clinical background checked before you interview
  • Interviews arranged online, on your schedule
  • Documents prepared for recognition
  • Ethical recruitment, with no fees charged to nurses

Questions

What nurses ask us.

Do I need to speak German before I start?

No. Most nurses start from the first word. We teach German from A1 up to the B1 or B2 level that the route needs.

Who can apply?

Nurses with a B.Sc Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc, M.Sc Nursing or GNM, registered with a State Nursing Council. Experience helps, and many employers prefer it. Send an enquiry and we will tell you honestly whether the route fits you now.

How long does the whole route take?

It depends mostly on how quickly you reach the German level you need. Language learning is usually the longest step. After your first call we give you a realistic plan with each step in order.

Do I pay a placement fee?

No. Digitaleem does not charge nurses a placement fee. Recruitment costs are paid by the employer.

Who pays for the German course?

That depends on the employer and the route. We explain every cost, and who covers it, before you commit to anything.

What is recognition?

Germany checks that your nursing qualification matches its own standard. This is called recognition (Anerkennung). If parts are missing, you complete an adaptation period or a knowledge exam in Germany, and you can work as a nursing assistant meanwhile.

Is Germany the only country?

Germany is our first route abroad. We will add other countries only when we can prepare people for them properly.

About Digitaleem

We work in the space between education and employment.

Digitaleem exists because finishing a course and being ready for work are not the same thing. We connect the people who can close that gap: students, colleges, industry and professionals.

The name

Digital + taleem.

Taleem means education. We chose the name because education is where every career starts. Our job is to make sure it does not stop there.

The Digitaleem mark is a D drawn as a journey. It starts at a single point, the learner, rises through education and curves round into work.

What we are, and are not

More than a course platform or a job board.

We are

  • A bridge between colleges and industry
  • A place to build practical skills and real work
  • A source of internships, industrial training and jobs
  • A route to careers abroad, starting with nursing in Germany
  • A way for professionals to help the next generation
  • Equally at home in IT, engineering, business and healthcare

We are not

  • Just an online course platform
  • Just an internship or job listing site
  • A conventional coaching or training institute
  • Limited to IT
  • A promise of a job without the work to earn one

What we believe

Practice over theory

Every program includes applying what you learn to a real problem.

Evidence over claims

Projects, evaluations and feedback say more than a list of skills.

Industry early

Students should meet their industry long before the placement drive.

Every starting point counts

Students join at different stages, and each one deserves the right next step.

When a college asks

When a company asks

The student journey

Seven stages, many ways in.

The journey is not a straight line. A student might need foundations, a project, an internship or only interview practice. Each stage has a matching program.

  1. Education

    Start building practical skills alongside your course, and talk to people who work in your field.

  2. Skill development

    Take structured training in your field, with labs and a project in every program.

  3. Practical application

    Work on a real problem, with a mentor, and finish with work that has been evaluated.

  4. Experience

    Get an internship at a partner company, or industrial training at a plant or site.

  5. Assessment

    Take aptitude, technical and communication assessments, and get your project work evaluated.

  6. Career preparation

    Get your resume reviewed, practise mock interviews and learn to explain your projects well.

  7. Employment

    Apply for internships and jobs listed by companies that work with Digitaleem.

Privacy policy

Last updated 5 October 2026.

This policy explains what personal data Digitaleem collects through digitaleem.co, why we collect it and how we protect it. We process personal data in line with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

What we collect

  • Details you give us in enquiry and application forms: your name, phone number, email address, institution or company, course, and the answers to the questions on the form.
  • Links you share with us, such as a resume, portfolio or LinkedIn profile.
  • Basic technical data your browser sends when you visit the site, such as pages viewed and device type.

Why we use it

  • To respond to your enquiry and recommend the right program or service.
  • To share your application with a company, only for an opening you applied to.
  • To match students, colleges, companies and mentors when you have asked us to.
  • To improve the website.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your data. We share it only with the company, college or mentor involved in what you asked for, and with service providers who help us run the website and handle forms, under agreements that protect your data.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiry and application data for as long as we need it to serve you, and then delete it, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you, or withdraw your consent to being contacted. To do so, email us at contact@digitaleem.co.

Changes

We will update this page if this policy changes.
